issues.description: ArrayHelpers helper method is named differently across artifacts: the template ArrayHelpers defines a method named 'appendElement(T[] array, T element)' while the template Stock.addToStockIngredients(...) calls ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray(...). The solution and examples use 'addElementToArray(...)'. This naming mismatch causes a compilation error in the provided template (undefined method) and will block students from building or following the provided examples.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the helper method name consistent. Rename the method in the template ArrayHelpers from 'appendElement' to 'addElementToArray' with signature 'public static <T> T[] addElementToArray(T[] array, T element)', matching the solution and call sites. Alternatively, add a delegating method 'addElementToArray' in the template that calls the existing 'appendElement' to preserve compatibility.
